rows.label: water
rows.description: chemical compound whose molecules are formed by two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom
rows.hook: covers most of the Earth's surface and is essential to every known form of life

rows.label: ethanol
rows.hook: is the intoxicating ingredient in beer, wine and spirits, and is also blended into fuel

rows.label: caffeine
rows.description: chemical compound used as a stimulant
rows.hook: is the stimulant in coffee, tea and energy drinks that helps people stay awake

rows.label: sodium bicarbonate
rows.hook: is the baking staple that makes cakes rise and is used in classic volcano science fair projects

rows.label: hydrogen peroxide
rows.hook: is a pale blue liquid used to bleach hair and to disinfect small cuts

rows.label: aspirin
rows.description: medication used to treat pain and decrease the risk of heart disease
rows.hook: is a common over-the-counter pill for headaches and fever, taken in low doses to protect the heart

rows.label: carbon dioxide
rows.hook: puts the fizz in soda, is exhaled by people, and is the main gas behind global warming

rows.label: sulfuric acid
rows.hook: is the main liquid inside traditional car batteries and is a highly corrosive industrial chemical

rows.label: acetic acid
rows.hook: gives vinegar its sharp smell and sour taste

rows.label: benzene
rows.description: hydrocarbon compound consisting of a 6-sided ring

rows.label: sodium chloride
rows.hook: is the seasoning found in shakers on nearly every dinner table

rows.label: glycerol
rows.hook: is a thick, sweet, syrupy liquid used in soaps, lotions and as a base for making explosives

rows.label: citric acid
rows.hook: gives lemons and limes their sour bite and is added to sour candy

rows.label: sucrose
rows.description: disaccharide made of glucose and fructose
rows.hook: is ordinary table sugar, extracted from cane or beets

rows.label: calcium carbonate
rows.hook: is the main ingredient of chalk, limestone and seashells

rows.label: carbon monoxide
rows.hook: is an odorless, invisible gas from faulty heaters that can silently poison people indoors

rows.label: silicon dioxide
rows.hook: is the main ingredient in sand and quartz, and is melted to make glass

rows.label: ethylene glycol
rows.description: organic compound used in the making of polyester fibers and in antifreeze formulations
rows.hook: is the sweet-tasting but poisonous liquid that keeps car radiators from freezing

rows.label: magnesium sulfate
rows.hook: is the Epsom salt people dissolve in a bath to soothe sore muscles

rows.label: naphthalene
rows.hook: is the pungent white solid traditionally used to make mothballs
